definitions.gloss: preliminary figure; flash estimate; initial report value
definitions.explanation: A provisional numerical value released quickly after data collection, before thorough verification. Commonly used for economic indicators like GDP, trade statistics, and employment figures that are published in stages — first as a preliminary estimate, then revised.

examples.japanese: {速報値|そくほうち}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
GDPの{速報値|そくほうち}は{前期比|ぜんきひ}プラス0.5%だった。
examples.english: The preliminary GDP figure was plus 0.5% compared to the previous quarter.

examples.japanese: {速報値|そくほうち}はあくまで{暫定的|ざんていてき}なもので、{確定値|かくていち}は{来月|らいげつ}{発表|はっぴょう}される{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: The preliminary figure is strictly provisional; the final value is scheduled to be announced next month.

notes:
Composed of {速報|そくほう} (flash report, breaking news) and {値|ち} (value, figure). This term appears frequently in news broadcasts and financial reporting. The {速報値|そくほうち} is typically followed by a {改定値|かいていち} (revised figure) and finally a {確定値|かくていち} (final/confirmed figure).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {速報値|そくほうち}を{発表|はっぴょう}する: to announce the preliminary figure
- {速報値|そくほうち}を{上方修正|じょうほうしゅうせい}する: to revise the preliminary figure upward
- {速報値|そくほうち}を{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい}する: to revise the preliminary figure downward

RELATED WORDS:
- {速報|そくほう}: flash report, bulletin — the quick-release report itself
- {確報値|かくほうち}: confirmed report value — the finalized figure
- {確定値|かくていち}: final confirmed value — the last revision
- {改定値|かいていち}: revised value — the intermediate revision
